notes.title: Patch Notes: 0.0.9
notes.notes: [p][b]This update introduces major systems to the homeworld, including new resources, buildings, inventory logic, player stat changes, UI polish, save/load functionality, and the foundation for research progression.[/b][/p][hr][/hr][h3]New: Inventory System[/h3][list][*][p]Implemented a full inventory system with clear separation between [b]Resources[/b] and [b]Items[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Resources[/b] (e.g. oil, power, research points) are kept on death.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Items[/b] (e.g. tools, consumables, blueprints) are lost on death, introducing a risk-reward element to exploration, expanding on the roguelike aspects.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]Player Stat Change: Overheating[/h3][list][*][p]Replaced [b]Stamina[/b] with a new [b]Overheating[/b] system.[/p][/*][*][p]Performing tasks builds up heat over time.[/p][/*][*][p]Overheating reduces performance and requires cooldown periods.[/p][/*][*][p]Reflects the robotic nature of your character and adds tension during prolonged activity.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]New Resource: Research Points[/h3][list][*][p]Research Points have been added as a new collectible and storable resource.[/p][/*][*][p]Used to unlock advanced technologies, upgrades, and blueprints.[/p][/*][*][p]Earned by defeating enemies, completing objectives, or processing rare materials.[/p][/*][*][p]Stored globally and persist through death and level transitions.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]New Resource: Oil[/h3][list][*][p]Added as a key fuel resource for your base.[/p][/*][*][p]Extracted from the environment using Oil Extractors.[/p][/*][*][p]Used to fuel power generators and some crafting recipes.[/p][/*][*][p]Stored in Oil Tanks for efficient management and long-term use.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]New Resource: Power[/h3][list][*][p]Power has been added as a core energy resource for your base.[/p][/*][*][p]Used to operate buildings, machinery, and automation systems.[/p][/*][*][p]Generated by oil-fuelled and solar generators.[/p][/*][*][p]Stored in Power Cores to provide backup and ensure steady supply.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]Building System Enhancements[/h3][list][*][p]Building component system updated for better performance, modularity, and resource logic handling.[/p][/*][*][p]Prepared for future expansion with an easy-to-use modular framework to support quick feature additions and scalability.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]New Buildings[/h3][list][*][p][b]Oil Extractor[/b] – Extracts raw oil from environmental patches.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Power Generator[/b] – Consumes oil to produce power.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Solar Generator[/b] – Produces free power during the daytime, with no fuel cost.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Oil Tank[/b] – Stores large amounts of refined oil.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Power Core[/b] – Stores generated power for later use.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]UI Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]Expanded resource UI with updated icons, resource bars, and contextual tooltips.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved building placement feedback and alignment visuals.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]Save / Load System[/h3][list][*][p]Full Save and Load system now active.[/p][/*][*][p]Autosave occurs:[/p][list][*][p]On level transitions[/p][/*][*][p]During major player actions (e.g. placing buildings)[/p][/*][*][p]At 5-minute set intervals[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list]

notes.title: Devlog: 03
notes.notes:
[u][b][h2]Where we're at!
[/h2][/b][/u]
Although we're still at the early stages of Development, Astromattech is at a point in the process where we have a fully working and demonstratable prototype. There are many things that need to be worked upon and many changes that still need to be made however as they say, "Rome wasn't built overnight".
The road ahead is long, but every step forward is a victory in its own right.

One thing I've learned for sure though is that game development is rarely a straight line, it's full of unexpected turns and challenges, issues and surprises but that is what makes the journey so rewarding.

Right now, players begin in an empty hub-world with three pre-set core structures: a portal, an "Upgrade bench" and a "Robot Constructor". While the building system is functional, allowing players to customise their base with environmental assets, we're still in the early phases of this system so crafting recipes and materials aren't yet incorporated into the game.

At this time the portal opens a testing menu with three selections, a preset world which will follow a linear storyline where the maps will be completely designed and preset by the team' a planet environment with randomised foliage and colour schemes and a space-station with randomised rooms. At the minute the randomisation is very basic and primarily consists of 2 types of rooms and a hallway, but the concept is there, and it works. That's what matters right now.

In the place of combat the game currently features three basic enemy types: the "Zombie" droid which will follow the player and explode upon contact, damaging all players in a set radius. The "Gunner" enemy, whose accuracy is intentionally poor (Think of a stormtrooper) and an AOE shooter type that spawns 6 projectiles in all cardinal directions.

These basic enemies essentially serve as cannon fodder to help players learn the games core mechanics, whilst allowing you to experiment with different weapons and abilities. I'm hoping over the coming weeks to release a kind of "Fact sheet" for each enemy, with detailed breakdowns of their weapons, abilities and characteristics so stay tuned for this.

At this point in development my primary focus is set on refining the visuals of Astromattech, working on improving environmental textures, adding in dynamic lighting and upgrading the character models to make everything feel more polished and immersive. The hub-world will also be getting a complete visual overhaul but more of this will be discussed on a dedicated post.

There's a lot to look forward to in the coming weeks and I'm excited to share the development process with you. Whether it's new mechanics, visual upgrades or deeper dives into the story of Astromattech your feedback and thoughts are incredibly valuable as we shape this project into what we hope to create. Please don't hesitate to share your ideas or ask any questions, I can't wait to show you what's coming next!

notes.title: Devlog: 02
notes.notes:
[u][b][h2]What is Astromattech?
[/h2][/b][/u]
Astromattech is a top-down, Twin-Stick Shooter / Bullet Hell game designed to challenge your skills and engross you in a cooperative experience like no other.

From a young age, Video Games have given me a sense of freedom and adventure; I vividly remember the days when I'd go to my friend's house, Gameboy in hand and we'd lose ourselves playing games like Pokémon and Mario until the streetlights turned on and we knew it was time to go home. As I grew, so did the games we'd play, from Pokémon to Halo, from RuneScape to World of Warcraft and many, many different worlds. 

One thing however remained constant, the joy of exploring new realms side by side with my friends, sharing the experience together.

It is this very feeling that has inspired me to create Astromattech, this game is about cooperation, leveraging your teammates unique abilities to defeat waves of mighty robots, fierce bosses and alien invaders. Complete challenging objectives and explore a galaxy of different environments and settings. It's not just about the gameplay but about the experience of working together towards a common goal.

Astromattech is set in a distant galaxy where artificial intelligence has surpassed humanity and robotics dominate. Your only goal is progress, defeating your enemies, salvaging their parts and using their loot to create new machinery, discover new technology and become the ultimate robot there is.

You'll start off as a damaged, lonesome servant droid with a corrupted hard drive. You're lost with no recollection of who you are or where you've come from and as far as the lens can see you're stranded in a desolate wasteland filled with the waste of those before you. Your first task is simple, you need to escape these ruins and establish a base of operations. It's from here that the adventure unfolds. Raid enemy bases, explore hostile planets, battle waves of pirates, raiders and creepy aliens.  Every encounter brings its own unique challenge, survival is the ultimate goal.

Are you ready to rebuild, create and annihilate?

notes.title: Devlog: 01
notes.notes:
[h2][u][b]Welcome to Astromattech!
[/b][/u][/h2]

[h3][u][b]Introducing the Studio!
[/b][/u][/h3]

Hello and welcome! We are Aevum Interactive, a small Indie studio based in Cheshire, United Kingdom. Our passion for games is what drives us to create the best possible experiences for our players. We are a small team however our aspirations are mighty.

Our goal is to create games that are not only entertaining but also meaningful, creating stories, evoking emotions and leaving a lasting impression on our players. Games have always held a meaningful place within our lives, we want to create that very same feeling for others.

[h3][u][b]Our Plan!
[/b][/u][/h3]

We believe that the best games are created by not only the minds of the developers, but the minds of those that play. We are committed to engaging with our players at every stage of development, we want to hear your thoughts and ideas, we want you to have your say to make a game you love.

Our goal is to create a collaborative environment where players and developers can work together to create something truly special. We want our players to feel like they are a part of the process, and we want them to be proud of the games that we create together.

To achieve this, we will be hosting regular playtests and surveys to gather feedback from our players. We will also be active on our Discord community and various social media platforms, so that we can engage with our community and hear your thoughts and opinions.

We want to thank our community in advance for their support, and we can't wait to see what we can create together!

We are excited to embark on this journey and can't wait to share our games with you. Stay tuned for updates and announcements as we continue to grow and develop as a studio.

Thank you for joining us on this adventure!
